prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a MOBILE FIRST-VIEWPORT of the provided approved homepage. The reference carries the exact style and copy, NOT desktop layout. Output one portrait image 1024x1536 representing a 390px-wide phone viewport at high resolution. This is the first screen ONLY: content continues naturally below the bottom edge. It is NOT the entire long page squeezed into a screen. No device frame. Absolutely no outer side margins larger than 70 image pixels (27 CSS px); content extends from x=65 to x=959. Body font must be clean sans serif approximately 44 IMAGE pixels so it reads as 17px on the phone. Title serif approximately 106 IMAGE pixels, on two clear lines "Afterlife" and "for an Atheist". Slim top row Reader survey at left and System theme dropdown at right, readable ~36px, thin rule. Title followed by exact explanatory copy: "Choose a chapter to rate how convincing you found its case for an afterlife and read or leave comments." Wrap naturally across 4–5 lines, never shrink type to fit. Then the SAME quiet abstract ink study adapted to a shallow ~230px high illustration, without taking over the screen. Then Chapters, "Select the chapter you have read.", and the start of the full-width numbered contents list. Show the first two or three chapter rows, "01 Chapter 1 →", "02 Chapter 2 →", "03 Chapter 3 →" as space allows; each row ~135 image pixels tall for a 51px touch target. Remaining chapters and footer continue below the screen and MUST NOT be crammed into this first viewport. Preserve off-white #F5F3ED, charcoal text, moss accents, fine rules. No new copy, no decorative card boxes, no slogans, no watermark. The image must read as a phone screen with comfortably large controls, not a narrow desktop page.
approvalScope: Visual mockups and interface wording; public launch requires a separate working-site review
